triage.tracing-subscriber: ANSI escape injection in logs. GHSA and RustSec IDs describe the same issue. Present through ark/risc0-groth16. Review untrusted log formatting; not evidence of forged proofs.

productionVerdict: Do not claim production security. Complete reachability review and controlled dependency remediation. Preserve toolchain/verifier compatibility and regenerate affected guest/proof evidence.
